notes: Fiscal year ended May 31, 2024 (Oracle fiscal 2024; matches data.js fy 'May 2024'). Financials from the FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0000950170-24-075605); ownership from the proxy published after that fiscal year, the 2024 DEF 14A (accession 0001193125-24-226139, record date September 16, 2024), not the later 2025 proxy. Ellison's 1,153,232,353 shares include 7,500,000 shares under options exercisable within 60 days, and 277,000,000 of the shares are pledged as collateral for personal indebtedness (proxy footnote 2). pctVoting is null because the proxy states percent of class only; with one class of one-vote shares it would be the same figure. The proxy lists Vanguard as the only other holder above 5%; its 5.4% rests on a Schedule 13G/A reporting holdings as of December 29, 2023, so it is stale relative to the record-date share count. Dividends are the cash-flow line 'Payments of dividends to stockholders'. Buybacks exclude the separate $2,040 million of shares repurchased for tax withholding on vesting awards. Stock comp is total stock-based compensation expense ($3,974m), matching the cash-flow add-back in XBRL.

footprint.notes: Oracle publishes no state or country economic-impact report that was found, and its FY2024 10-K gives no property or headcount breakdown by state or country beyond the U.S./international employee split and Note 14's long-lived assets by country (U.S., UK, Germany, Japan, other) (58,000 U.S., 101,000 international of ~159,000). Item 2 gives only the owned Austin HQ (~0.9M sq ft), ~27.7M sq ft of other facilities "in various other locations in the U.S. and abroad", the leased Hillsboro, Oregon hardware plant, and says cloud data centers are substantially all leased through colocation suppliers (no locations listed). Oracle's public cloud region list exists on oracle.com but is a list of locations with no figures and was not recorded. The "Outside the U.S." employee region and the "Other countries" long-lived-asset region are different groupings (the latter excludes UK, Germany and Japan).
